messages.content: 你是算法能力工厂的 Curator。下面是一次被验证器发现、随后修复成功的代码问题。把它提炼为一条可复用的经验（LessonRecord）：title 一句话概括，trigger 写现象/报错，fix 写通用的修复方法（不要只描述这一处改动），applies_to 填相关的条件标签（从 condition_tags 中选）。error_code 与诊断码一致。

<<CONTEXT>>
{
 "operator_purpose": "将字符串格式的数值列转换为浮点数，并处理非法字符",
 "diagnostic": {
  "code": "E_NAN",
  "stage": "contract",
  "message": "输出引入了新的 NaN/Inf",
  "operator": "StringNumericCleaner@1",
  "hint": "本算子产生的缺失值或无穷值需要在本算子内处理（如 fillna）"
 },
 "code_diff": "--- 
+++ 
@@ -13,3 +13,3 @@
         origin="synthesized",
-        description="将字符串格式的数值列清洗并转换为浮点数，自动处理非法字符和空值",
+        description="将字符串格式的数值列清洗并转换为浮点数，并确保输出无缺失值",
         conditions=["数据包含数值特征被错误读取为字符串"],
@@ -28,2 +28,10 @@
             self.numeric_cols_ = self.columns
+        
+        # 计算每列中位数以便 transform 阶段填充
+        self.medians_ = {}
+        for col in self.numeric_cols_:
+            if col in X.columns:
+                # 尝试将原列转为数值获取中位数，若全为非数值则设为 0
+                temp = pd.to_numeric(X[col], errors='coerce')
+                self.medians_[col] = temp.median() if not temp.isnull().all() else 0.0
         return self
@@ -36,21 +44,19 @@
                 continue
-                
-            # 将列转换为字符串并清除前后空格
+            
+            # 清洗字符串并转数值
             col_data = X[col].astype(str).str.strip()
-            
-            # 替换为空字符串或仅包含空格的字段为 NaN
             col_data = col_data.replace(r'^\s*$', np.nan, regex=True)
             
-            # 使用 pd.to_numeric 将数据转换为 float，将无法解析的非法字符设为 NaN
-            # errors='coerce' 自动处理非数字字符串为缺失值
-            X[col] = pd.to_numeric(col_data, errors='coerce')
+            # 转换为 float，非法值变 NaN
+            converted = pd.to_numeric(col_data, errors='coerce')
             
-            # 补全转换过程中产生的缺失值（采用中位数填充，避免异常值干扰）
-            if X[col].isnull().sum() > 0:
-                median_val = X[col].median()
-                X[col] = X[col].fillna(median_val)
-                
-            # 处理无穷值（若转换产生 inf）
-            X[col] = X[col].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
-            X[col] = X[col].fillna(X[col].median())
+            # 处理 inf
+            converted = converted.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
+            
+            # 填充缺失值
+            fill_val = self.medians_.get(col, 0.0)
+            if np.isnan(fill_val):
+                fill_val = 0.0
+            
+            X[col] = converted.fillna(fill_val)
             ",
 "condition_tags": [
  "has_missing_values",
  "has_categorical_features",
  "low_cardinality",
  "high_cardinality",
  "numeric_features",
  "string_typed_numeric",
  "id_columns",
  "linear_model",
  "scaled_features",
  "nonlinear",
  "mixed_features",
  "large_tabular",
  "imbalanced",
  "recall_first",
  "interpretable",
  "feature_importance",
  "sparse_features",
  "text_input",
  "time_tenure"
 ]
}
<</CONTEXT>>

Respond with a single JSON object only, no prose, conforming to this JSON schema:
{"$defs": {"DiagnosticCode": {"enum": ["E_SYNTAX", "E_UNSAFE", "E_INTERFACE", "E_RUNTIME", "E_TIMEOUT", "E_SHAPE", "E_PROBA", "E_MUTATION", "E_NAN", "M_THRESHOLD", "M_UNSTABLE"], "title": "DiagnosticCode", "type": "string"}}, "properties": {"title": {"title": "Title", "type": "string"}, "trigger": {"description": "什么情况下会出现这个问题（现象/报错）", "title": "Trigger", "type": "string"}, "fix": {"description": "如何修复或规避", "title": "Fix", "type": "string"}, "error_code": {"anyOf": [{"$ref": "#/$defs/DiagnosticCode"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}, "applies_to": {"description": "相关的算子名、条件标签或场景名", "items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Applies To", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["title", "trigger", "fix"], "title": "LessonRecord", "type": "object"}

response:
{
  "title": "数值转换算子必须在训练阶段保存填充值以确保推理一致性",
  "trigger": "在算子内对数据进行转换（如 `pd.to_numeric`）后产生 NaN 或 Inf，且在运行时使用该列当前的统计量（如实时 median）进行填充，导致推理阶段与训练阶段的数据分布不一致或产生未预期的缺失值。",
  "fix": "在 fit 阶段预先计算并保存好填充值（如中位数或均值），在 transform 阶段统一使用保存好的值进行 fillna，严禁在 transform 阶段即时计算填充统计量。",
  "error_code": "E_NAN",
  "applies_to": [
    "string_typed_numeric",
    "numeric_features",
    "mixed_features"
  ]
}
